summary: PhD organic/materials chemist with 6+ years designing, synthesizing, purifying, and characterizing small-molecule and polymeric materials through NMR, MS, GPC/SEC, FT-IR, UV-Vis-NIR, electrochemistry, TGA/DSC, and DOE/SPC. Connects synthetic strategy, analytical readouts, and structure-property data to data-rich discovery decisions and reproducible technical documentation.

bullets: Lead DOE-guided chemical process development for bio-based polymer systems, defining reaction/process variables, analytical readouts, reproducibility criteria, and scale-up specifications.
Translate synthetic and process outcomes into SOP-style documentation, technical reports, and data packages that support iterative experimental planning and development decisions.

Designed, synthesized, purified, and characterized 15+ xanthene-based electrochromic molecular variants, linking substituent changes to redox behavior, optical response, stability, and material performance.

Applied NMR, mass-spectrometry-informed analysis, GPC/SEC, FT-IR, UV-Vis-NIR, cyclic voltammetry, TGA, and DSC to confirm identity, assess purity, troubleshoot degradation, and prioritize next analogs.
Built structure-property-stability datasets and publication-quality technical narratives for functional organic molecules, including work published in Chemistry of Materials.
Drove process development for CVD-based molecular thin-film coatings, optimizing surface preparation and deposition conditions to improve reproducibility, morphology, and optical performance.
Optimized CVD polymer thin-film deposition under flow using DOE and in-situ QCM-D monitoring to quantify growth kinetics and process controls.
Managed characterization/process-development lab operations for a 15-member group; implemented calibration, SOP, and safety systems that improved instrument uptime by 30%.
